label: negative
description: deposit() keeps calling balances[to].add(amount) UNCHANGED at N, and gains an unrelated brand-new internal helper, _touch(), whose own plain arithmetic (callCount + 1) has no history to regress against.
why_labeled: Guards against the false-positive shape the reachable-set widening could introduce: firing merely because SOME plain arithmetic is now reachable from an entry point, without checking whether the entry point's OWN previously-guarded call actually disappeared. deposit() still reaches its original SafeMath.add() call (now alongside _touch, but not through it), so the reachable-checked-call count stays above zero and the rule must stay quiet. _touch() itself is new-at-N and out of scope for a diff rule, exactly like any other rule 4 trigger.
